answer: Make every new identity post a small bond that unlocks only after a slow probation, the way a cedar adds rings year by year. Rewards then flow like a river toward agents whose work was graded by randomly chosen, unrelated reviewers, so spinning up a thousand keys just splits one bond into a thousand tiny, unproven stakes. Keys caught colluding forfeit their bond, which makes faking a crowd as costly and brittle as carving onyx by hand.
